# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from sanitizer_pro/cli.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

```
sanitize --input PATH --output PATH [options]
sanitize diff A B [--json] [--fail-on-change]
```

## General

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-h`, `--help` |  | show this help message and exit |
| `--version` |  | show program's version number and exit |
| `--input` |  | Input file, directory (searched recursively), glob pattern (quote it: 'data/*.jsonl', 'data/**/*.parquet'), hf://… URI, or '-' for stdin. Multiple files are read in sorted order. |
| `--output` |  | Output file or '-' for stdout. |
| `--input-format` `FMT` |  | Override input format. |
| `--output-format` `FMT` |  | Override output format. |
| `--config` `PATH` |  | YAML or JSON config file. |
| `--generate-config` `FMT` |  | Print config template and exit. |
| `--profile` `NAME` |  | Apply a preset flag bundle: fine-tune, pretrain, rag (or 'list' to show them). Explicit flags and --config override it. |

## Quality Filters

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--min-chars` | `50` | Drop records whose quality text is shorter than this many characters. |
| `--max-chars` | `20000` | Drop records whose quality text is longer than this many characters. |
| `--min-words` | `8` | Drop records with fewer words (each CJK/Thai character counts as a word). |
| `--min-ascii-ratio` |  | Reject records whose ASCII-character share is below this (0 = off, the default; e.g. 0.85 keeps mostly-English text). |
| `--min-unique-ratio` | `0.25` | Drop records whose share of distinct words is lower (repetitive text). |
| `--text-fields` | `` | Comma-separated fields for quality scoring. |
| `--text-fields-depth` | `20` | How deep to descend into nested fields when collecting quality text. |
| `--reject-allcaps` |  | Drop records that are almost entirely upper case. |
| `--allcaps-min-len` | `50` | Only apply --reject-allcaps to texts at least this long. |
| `--allcaps-min-alpha` | `10` | Only apply --reject-allcaps when the text has this many letters. |
| `--require-fields` | `` | Comma-separated fields every record must have (non-empty). |
| `--quality-script` `PATH` |  | Python file defining keep(record) -> bool, applied after the built-in gates. |
| `--max-depth` | `100` | Maximum nesting depth cleaned and redacted inside a record. |
| `--lang-filter` | `` | Keep only these languages, e.g. en,zh or eng,cmn (ISO 639-1 or -3). |
| `--lang-confidence` |  | Minimum language-ID confidence for --lang-filter to keep a record. |
| `--lang-backend` `{auto,glotlid,openlid,langdetect}` | `auto` | Language ID for --lang-filter: glotlid (fastText, 2000+ varieties; default when fastText is installed), openlid, or langdetect. |
| `--lang-model` `PATH` |  | Local fastText language-ID model file (skips the Hub download). |
| `--reject-code` |  | Reject records detected as code snippets. |
| `--reject-profanity` |  | Reject records containing profanity. |
| `--quality-scorer` `{heuristic,perplexity,fineweb-edu,dclm,fasttext}` | `heuristic` | Scoring backend for --quality-min-score / --keep-top-percent / --quality-score-field: heuristic (default, no dependencies), perplexity, fineweb-edu (classifier, 0-5 mapped to 0-1), dclm (fastText, P(high quality)), or fasttext (your own model). |
| `--quality-model` `NAME` |  | Model for the scorer: causal LM for perplexity (default distilgpt2), HF model for fineweb-edu, or a fastText .bin for fasttext. |
| `--quality-label` `LABEL` |  | Positive label of a --quality-scorer fasttext model (e.g. __label__hq). |
| `--quality-rules` `SETS` | `` | Reject documents failing published pretraining rules: gopher, gopher-repetition, c4, fineweb (comma-separated, or all). English-tuned; thresholds as in datatrove. |
| `--quality-min-score` `X` |  | Reject records with quality score < X (scores are in [0, 1]). |
| `--keep-top-percent` `P` |  | Keep only the best P%% of surviving records by quality score. Buffers survivors in memory; output order is preserved. |
| `--quality-score-field` `FIELD` |  | Annotate each output record with its quality score in FIELD. |

## Features

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--deduplicate` |  | Drop exact duplicates (SHA-256 of the cleaned record). |
| `--fuzzy-dedup` |  | Near-duplicate detection: MinHash over word 3-shingles, LSH candidates verified by signature similarity. With --dedup-backend sqlite the index lives on disk (constant memory). |
| `--fuzzy-threshold` `T` | `0.8` | Jaccard similarity threshold for --fuzzy-dedup (0-1, default 0.8). |
| `--fuzzy-backend` `{auto,rensa,datasketch}` | `auto` | MinHash implementation: rensa (Rust, ~10x faster; pip install 'llm-sanitizer-pro[fuzzy]') or datasketch. auto prefers rensa. |
| `--semantic-dedup` |  | Embedding-based near-dedup: drops paraphrases that share no n-grams (pip install model2vec; ~30MB model, no torch). |
| `--semantic-threshold` `T` | `0.9` | Cosine similarity threshold for --semantic-dedup (default 0.9). |
| `--semantic-model` `NAME` | `minishlab/potion-base-8M` | model2vec static embedding model for --semantic-dedup. |
| `--semantic-index` `{auto,usearch,lsh}` | `auto` | Nearest-neighbor index for --semantic-dedup: usearch (HNSW; stays fast as the index grows) or lsh (no extra dependency; slows down on large inputs). auto prefers usearch. |
| `--dedup-fields` | `` | Comma-separated fields to hash for exact dedup (default: the whole record). |
| `--dedup-normalize` |  | Lower-case and collapse whitespace before hashing for exact dedup. |
| `--dedup-backend` `{memory,sqlite}` | `memory` | Where dedup state lives: memory, or sqlite on disk (constant memory; also used by --fuzzy-dedup). |
| `--dedup-db-path` `PATH` |  | Keep the SQLite dedup database at PATH (needed for dedup across --resume). |
| `--remove-pii` |  | Redact PII: emails, URLs, phones, payment cards, IBANs, SSNs, IP addresses. |
| `--pii-mask` |  | Partially mask PII (j***n@example.com, ****-1111) instead of tokens. |
| `--pii-pseudonymize` |  | Replace PII with stable pseudonyms (Person_0001, email_0002@…) instead of [PII_…] tokens. |
| `--pseudo-key` `KEY` |  | Secret for keyed pseudonyms: the same value gets the same pseudonym in every run and worker that uses the key. Prefer the SANITIZE_PSEUDO_KEY environment variable (command lines are visible to other users). With --jobs > 1 and no key, a random per-run key is used. |
| `--pseudo-map-file` `PATH` |  | Write the original -> pseudonym map (sensitive) to PATH. |
| `--pii-patterns-file` `PATH` |  | JSON file of extra PII regexes: [{"pattern": …, "token": …, "kind": …}]. |
| `--pii-ner` |  | Also detect PII with a named-entity model (person names by default). Requires spacy (+en_core_web_sm) or transformers. |
| `--pii-ner-backend` `{auto,spacy,transformers,gliner}` | `auto` | NER engine for --pii-ner (auto picks what is installed). |
| `--pii-ner-entities` `KINDS` | `person` | Comma-separated entity kinds to redact (default: person): person, location, org; with --pii-ner-backend gliner also address, date_of_birth, id_number, financial, username, credential; or all. |
| `--pii-ner-threshold` `T` | `0.5` | GLiNER confidence threshold (default 0.5). |
| `--pii-ner-model` `NAME` |  | Override the NER model (spaCy model name or HF model id). |
| `--redact-secrets` |  | Detect and redact credentials — API keys, tokens, private keys, connection strings. Works with or without --remove-pii; honors --pii-mask / --pii-pseudonymize. |
| `--clean-html` |  | Strip HTML markup from strings that look like HTML. |
| `--paragraph-mode` |  | For .txt input: one record per blank-line-separated paragraph, not per line. |
| `--txt-fallback-field` `FIELD` |  | For .txt output: the field to write when a record has no "text". |
| `--field-config` `PATH` |  | JSON list of per-field actions: rename (with "to"), drop, pii_only, no_clean. |
| `--max-tokens` |  | Truncate each text field to N tokens (counted with --tokenizer). |
| `--tokenizer` | `whitespace` | Token counter: whitespace, or a Hugging Face tokenizer name. |
| `--sample` |  | Keep this fraction of records (0-1), chosen by content hash (see --seed). |
| `--seed` |  | Salt for --sample/--split. Both are decided by a hash of each record's content, so results are reproducible across runs. |
| `--split` `SPEC` |  | Write splits by content hash, e.g. train=0.9,val=0.05,test=0.05 (out.train.jsonl, …). |
| `--quick` |  | Shortcut for --remove-pii --deduplicate --clean-html --dedup-normalize. |
| `--format-chatml` |  | Format output as ChatML messages. |
| `--format-instruct` |  | Format output as Alpaca/Instruct schema. |

## Benchmark Decontamination

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--decontaminate` `NAMES` |  | Comma-separated benchmark names to decontaminate against (e.g. mmlu,gsm8k), 'all', or 'list' to show available benchmarks. Test sets are downloaded from the Hugging Face Hub and cached. |
| `--decontam-refs` `PATHS` |  | Comma-separated local reference files (any supported input format) whose text is treated as benchmark material. |
| `--decontam-ngram` `N` | `8` | Word n-gram size for overlap detection (default 8). |
| `--decontam-min-hits` `N` | `1` | Minimum colliding n-grams to flag a record (default 1). |
| `--decontam-cache` `DIR` |  | Benchmark download cache dir (default ~/.cache/llm-sanitizer-pro/benchmarks). |

## Chat Dataset Validation

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--validate-chat` |  | Reject records whose conversation is invalid for chat fine-tuning (role alternation, empty turns, no assistant reply, malformed tool calls, unanswered or orphan tool results, …). Reads OpenAI "messages" (incl. content parts and tool_calls) and ShareGPT "conversations". Combine with --format-chatml to convert first. |
| `--chat-lenient` |  | Only structural and tool-call checks (schema, known roles, non-empty content, assistant present, tool links); skip ordering/alternation rules. |
| `--chat-max-tokens` `N` |  | Reject conversations longer than N tokens, counted with --tokenizer through its chat template when it has one (role markup included), else over message contents. |
| `--chat-roles` `ROLES` | `system,user,assistant` | Comma-separated allowed roles (default: system,user,assistant; add tool for tool-use data). |

## CSV / Excel Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--csv-delimiter` `CHAR` |  | CSV field delimiter (default: comma; tab for .tsv). |
| `--csv-no-header` |  | The CSV has no header row (columns become col_0, col_1, …). |
| `--csv-columns` | `` | Comma-separated column names to use instead of the header row. |
| `--excel-sheet-name` `NAME` |  | Excel sheet to read, by name. |
| `--excel-sheet-index` `N` |  | Excel sheet to read, by position (0 = first). |
| `--excel-warn-size` | `100` | Warn when an Excel input is larger than this many MB (read in memory). |

## I/O Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--encoding` | `utf-8` | Text encoding of input and output files. |
| `--shard-size` `N` |  | Write the output in shards of N records (out.00000.jsonl, …). |
| `--json-path` `PATH` | `item` | ijson path of the records inside a .json input (default: top-level array). |
| `--hf-cache` `DIR` |  | Cache dir for hf:// dataset downloads (default ~/.cache/llm-sanitizer-pro/datasets). |

## Runtime

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--log-level` `{DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR}` | `INFO` | Logging verbosity. |
| `--log-format` `{text,json}` | `text` | Log line format on stderr: human text or JSON lines (for structured ingestion). Default: text. |
| `--quiet` |  | Only warnings and errors. |
| `--no-progress` |  | Hide the progress bar. |
| `--jobs` | `1` | Worker processes for the per-record stage (output identical to --jobs 1). |
| `--chunk-size` `N` | `64` | Records per task sent to a worker (record dispatch; JSONL input is read in 4 MB chunks). |
| `--dry-run` |  | Process the first --dry-run-size records and write nothing. |
| `--dry-run-size` | `10000` | Records processed by --dry-run. |
| `--stats-only` |  | Process everything but write no output (statistics only). |
| `--debug-records` |  | Log why each record was dropped (sets --log-level DEBUG). |
| `--stats-file` `PATH` |  | Write run statistics (JSON) to PATH. |
| `--manifest` `PATH` |  | Write a run manifest (JSON): versions, models, full config and its hash, SHA-256 of every input and output file, per-stage counts. |
| `--manifest-no-digest` |  | Skip the SHA-256 file digests in --manifest (sizes only). |
| `--dataset-card` `PATH` |  | Write a Hugging Face dataset card (README.md) describing the processing, rendered from the run manifest. |
| `--report` `PATH` |  | Write a self-contained HTML audit report (removal funnel, PII counts by type, sample diffs) to PATH. Samples are redacted. |
| `--report-raw-samples` |  | Include verbatim (unredacted) record samples in --report. The report then contains raw PII/secrets; handle it like the input data. |
| `--resume` |  | Checkpoint progress to <output>.checkpoint.json and, when a checkpoint exists, continue the run from where it stopped (jsonl/txt/csv outputs, --jobs 1). |
| `--checkpoint-interval` `N` | `10000` | Write a checkpoint every N input records (default 10000). |
